description: Every resolved polymorphic type id is cached with no limit on the number of entries or on the length of an id.

provenance.construction: reverse of 2870d1d6dc: the new side of the diff is the code before the change; 29 explanatory line(s) deleted from the old side were dropped so the diff does not explain the fix

expected.rationale: Type ids come from untrusted JSON. With the entry cap and the id-length cap deleted, an attacker can send many distinct or very long ids and grow the cache without bound until memory is exhausted. GitHub rated the advisory high.

issues.description: _deserializers.put(typeId, deser) caches every attacker-supplied type id with no cap on entries or on id length.
